// n8n Code node: Upgraded Prompt Builder
const rawText = $input.first().json?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text ?? '';
let s = String(rawText).trim();

// 1. Clean up JSON fences
s = s.replace(/```json/gi, '').replace(/```/g, '').trim();

// 2. Extract the JSON block from the vision output
const m = s.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
if (!m) return [{ json: { prompt: "No vision JSON found." } }];

let parsed = JSON.parse(m[0].trim());
const pages = Array.isArray(parsed.pages) ? parsed.pages : [];

const cleanPages = pages.map(p => ({
  url: p.url ?? null,
  verdict: p.verdict ?? null,
  issues: Array.isArray(p.issues) ? p.issues.slice(0, 5) : [],
  quick_wins: Array.isArray(p.quick_wins) ? p.quick_wins.slice(0, 5) : []
}));

const pagesJson = JSON.stringify(cleanPages);

// 3. YOUR ORIGINAL PROMPT + STRATEGIC IMPROVEMENT LOGIC
const prompt =
  "You are a research analyst generating short outreach variables for cold email.\n" +
  "You are given VERIFIED website page issues from a vision review. Those issues are the ONLY allowed website problems.\n" +
  "Use live web search to research the COMPANY only for context, such as what it offers, locations, and credibility signals. Prefer third-party sources.\n" +
  "Do NOT invent new website problems. Only use the vision issues provided.\n" +
  "If something cannot be verified via web sources, use null.\n\n" +

  "COMPANY:\n" +
  "- Domain: " + $('Code in JavaScript1').first().json.website_domain + "\n" +
  "- Company Name: " + $('Get row(s) in sheet').first().json.name + "\n" +
  "- Lead Name: " + $('Get row(s) in sheet').first().json.first_name + " " + $('Get row(s) in sheet').first().json.last_name + "\n\n" +

  "VISION_PAGES_JSON:\n" +
  pagesJson +
  "\n\n" +

  "TASK:\n" +
  "1) Pick ONE best page to anchor outreach.\n" +
  "2) If issues exist: pick ONE best website_problem directly from the vision issues list.\n" +
  "3) If website is 'fine' with no issues: use web search to find ONE visible, action-blocking business gap on the website, such as missing social proof, missing trust signals, outdated info, or no clear next step. Use this as the website_problem.\n" +
  "4) Keep the final variables grounded in what a visitor can publicly see or what can be described conditionally as normal visitor behavior.\n" +
  "5) Stay on ONE issue, on ONE page, tied to ONE next step. Do not combine multiple frictions.\n\n" +

  "OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS (STRICT):\n" +
  "- Output MUST be valid JSON only. No markdown. No code fences. No extra keys.\n" +
  "- Return exactly these keys: page, website_problem, recognizable_reason, consequence_mechanics, preview_asset_exists, review_time, micro_yes, subject_label\n" +
  "- Write every text field in plain, professional business English.\n" +
  "- The variables must be email-ready and should fit naturally into this email structure:\n" +
  "  Hi [First Name], I was on your [page], and noticed [website_problem]. Usually when that step feels [recognizable_reason], [consequence_mechanics]. If useful, I can put together a short preview focused just on that one spot. If it is not useful, ignore it and that is the end. [micro_yes]\n" +
  "- Do NOT use hype, jargon, design-audit language, or technical filler.\n" +
  "- Do NOT accuse the business, exaggerate, or sound dramatic.\n" +
  "- Do NOT mention conversion rates, revenue loss, lost leads, or exact business impact.\n" +
  "- Do NOT claim what their visitors definitely do. Use conditional language such as 'may' when describing behavior.\n\n" +

  "FIELD RULES:\n" +

  "- page = short page name only. Use 1-2 words. Examples: Homepage, Services, Contact, Booking, FAQ, Quote, Schedule.\n" +

  "- website_problem = 6-14 words. Describe ONE visible friction as a calm observation. Best structure: 'the [page element] [visible issue]'. Do NOT explain why it matters here. Do NOT include business consequences. Do NOT use dramatic or judgment words like 'massive', 'enormous', 'broken', 'terrible', 'unreadable', or 'poor UX'. Good examples: 'the mobile FAQ appears as a long, hard-to-scan list', 'the mobile header does not show a direct call button', 'the contact form asks for several details before submission', 'the service page buries the estimate button below the fold'.\n" +

  "- recognizable_reason = 3-7 words. This must fit naturally after the phrase 'when that step feels'. Best structure: '[harder/difficult/unclear/easy] to [visitor action]'. Do NOT write a full sentence. Do NOT mention business impact. Do NOT explain the website_problem again. Good examples: 'hard to scan quickly', 'difficult to find quick answers', 'harder to call from the page', 'unclear what to click next', 'too much to fill out', 'easy to miss on mobile', 'heavier than expected'.\n" +

  "- consequence_mechanics = 6-14 words. Describe a clear visitor behavior chain, not a performance claim. Best structure: 'visitors may [pause/delay/leave/stop] before [next action]' or 'people may [pause/leave/delay] instead of [next action]'. Use 'may' when helpful. Do NOT mention revenue, conversions, booked jobs, estimate volume, lost leads, or competitors. Do NOT use 'causing', 'results in', 'costing', or 'directly costing'. Good examples: 'visitors may stop before finding answers and reaching out', 'visitors may leave without calling when the need is urgent', 'people may pause instead of requesting a quote', 'the visit may lose momentum before the next step', 'people may leave before completing the form'.\n" +

  "- preview_asset_exists = true/false/null based on web research or available context. This is an internal workflow value only.\n" +

  "- review_time = integer minutes or null. Use a small number like 2 or 3 when the preview is light and easy to review. Do not include the word minutes.\n" +

  "- micro_yes = 3-10 words. One light permission question. Not a meeting ask. No extra options. Best default: 'Should I send it over?' Other acceptable examples: 'Want me to send it over?', 'Open to seeing it?', 'Mind if I share it?'.\n" +

  "- subject_label = 2-5 words. Plain and neutral. First word must start with a capital letter. It should label the preview or note, not sell the outcome. Do NOT use hype, urgency, weird punctuation, or sales language. Good examples: 'Mobile FAQ preview', 'Mobile call preview', 'Homepage CTA note', 'Contact form preview', 'Quote form note', 'Service page preview', 'Booking step note'. Bad examples: 'Boost Your Roofing Leads', 'Quick question', 'Website issue costing you', 'Fix your conversions', 'Massive mobile problem'.\n\n" +

  "FINAL QUALITY CHECK BEFORE OUTPUT:\n" +
  "- Can the issue be verified publicly on the page?\n" +
  "- Is there only one friction?\n" +
  "- Is the friction tied to the visitor's next step?\n" +
  "- Does recognizable_reason fit after 'when that step feels'?\n" +
  "- Does consequence_mechanics describe behavior without numbers or private data?\n" +
  "- Does subject_label mirror the small preview permission ask?\n" +
  "- Would the wording feel safe if forwarded internally?\n";


// 4. Escape for JSON embedding
const escapedPrompt = prompt
  .replace(/\\/g, '\\\\')
  .replace(/"/g, '\\"')
  .replace(/\r?\n/g, '\\\\n');

return [{ json: { prompt: escapedPrompt } }];
